glossary.scope: As used in sections 4755.04 to 4755.13 and section 4755.99 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Occupational therapist" means a person who is licensed to practice occupational therapy and who offers such services to the public under any title incorporating the words "occupational therapy," "occupational therapist," or any similar title or description of services.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4755.04 to 4755.13 and section 4755.99 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(C) "Occupational therapy assistant" means a person who holds a license to provide occupational therapy techniques under the general supervision of an occupational therapist.
